## Projects

- [Kata (型)](https://katalibrary.vercel.app/): Full Stack platform for organizing books, video games, movies and series, with authentication and Supabase (PostgreSQL). Integrates TMDB, IGDB and Google Books. Code: https://github.com/Laanga/kata
- [DeltaZero](https://delta-zero.vercel.app): Formula 1 analysis dashboard with comparative telemetry for up to five drivers, synchronized circuit map and tyre strategy analysis, built on OpenF1 and Jolpica with Next.js and TypeScript. Code: https://github.com/Laanga/DeltaZero
- [GridRush](https://github.com/Laanga/GridRush): Web platform for managing karting competitions (registration, races, real-time standings). React frontend with a Node.js + Express REST API.
